messages:
maya: heads-up: after the latest client bundle were seeing a subtle policy mismatch. SDKs are attaching an X-Route-Preference header and the router policy is treating it as an authoritative route even when tenants have pinned models.

oliver: can you paste a minimal repro? wondering if header name changed or if value formats differ.

maya: repro curl:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\  
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \\  
  -H 'X-Route-Preference: quick' \\  
  -d '{"input":"status"}'
```

sam: replayed span id span-e52. console traces show tenant pin=stable-v2 but router matched on X-Route-Preference and forwarded to quick-pool. billing reflects quick-pool increments.

izzy: did the SDK start sending that header by default? we intentionally reserve route headers for integrators.

maya: yes — the new convenience layer in TS and Py started adding route prefetch hints to help local dev. apparently it went out without an opt-in flag.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: router-ignore-client-routehint -> canary by izzy at 6185000100

oliver: short-term: patch router to ignore client-originated X-Route-* headers unless tenant explicitly opted-in via account flag. Also emit metric routing.client_header_ignored.

sam: agree. patch the SDKs to stop adding X-Route-Preference by default and add a prominent changelog entry.

izzy: adding a console tile: tenant | pinned_model | header_routehint | routed_pool | mismatch_count (24h). alert if mismatch_rate > 0.1% for paid tenants.

maya: I'll open the py/ts PRs and coordinate the release. can someone own the router change?

izzy: I'll own router change + unit test, will canary it to regional canaries. adding metric routing.client_header_ignored and log line when we drop a client routehint.

oliver: long-term: add an integration test in CI that runs a client with default config and ensures tenant pins take precedence over any client hints. also update SDK docs to clearly state we do not guarantee header semantics unless explicitly enabled.

maya: TL;DR: stop sending client route hints by default (sdk patches); router ignore client hints unless tenant opt-in; add metric + dashboard; monitor 72h. tagging @oliver @sam @izzy.

ops-bot: Deploy started: router-ignore-client-routehint -> canary (4 instances) at 6185000200
